svg.title: Access from anywhere through the exchange server
svg.desc: Detailed scheme. The exchange server at a public address keeps accounts, enrolled devices, the directory of folders and broadcasts, and a user log. Windows PCs with Fast Media Sorter & Sharing for Windows share folders over SFTP and work as clients; Android phones open any of those folders or share their own; a watch and an Android TV receive media. Every device keeps a control connection to the server; folders open through data tunnels the server splices.
